hooks.command: session=$(python3 -c "import json,os; print(json.load(open(os.path.join(os.getcwd(),'.claude/bus-config.json')))['session_name'])" 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$session" ] && exit 0; inbox="$HOME/.ai-bus/sessions/$session/inbox.d"; [ -d "$inbox" ] || exit 0; count=$(find "$inbox" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.json' 2>/dev/null | wc -l); [ "$count" -gt 0 ] && echo "Hub inbox: $count pending message(s) for session '$session'. Invoke /hub-workflow to claim and process."; exit 0

session=$(python3 -c "import json,os; print(json.load(open(os.path.join(os.getcwd(),'.claude/bus-config.json')))['session_name'])" 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$session" ] && exit 0; base="$HOME/.ai-bus/sessions/$session"; aw=$(find "$base/awaiting" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.json' 2>/dev/null | wc -l); ow=$(find "$base/owing" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.json' 2>/dev/null | wc -l); if [ "$aw" -gt 0 ] || [ "$ow" -gt 0 ]; then echo "Reply ledger: you are owed $aw repl(y/ies) and owe $ow. Run /check-inbox to reconcile."; python3 "$HOME/.ai-bus/lib/reply-watch.py" ensure >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; exit 0
